newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tohoku Bank applies for March 14 TSE listing.
newsitem.headline: Tohoku Bank applies for March 14 TSE listing.

text.p: Tohoku Bank Ltd, a regional bank, has applied to list its shares on the second section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on March 14, the exchange said in a statement on Thursday.
The bank plans to sell five million new shares through a public offering. Of the total, 2.5 million will be auctioned, the exchange said. The payment date is March 13.
The auction will be carried out on March 5, it said.
The public offer price has yet to be decided, it said.
